name: my100manga
description: 自分を構成する100の漫画を作って共有するサイト

scripts.deploy:dev: npm run build && wrangler deploy --env dev --assets dist/public --minify
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run build && wrangler deploy --env='' --assets dist/public --minify
scripts.deploy:r18:dev: npm run build && wrangler deploy --env r18dev --assets dist/public --minify
scripts.deploy:r18:prod: npm run build && wrangler deploy --env r18 --assets dist/public --minify
scripts.db:init:remote:dev: wrangler d1 execute DB --env dev --remote --file db/schema.sql
scripts.db:init:remote:r18:dev: wrangler d1 execute DB --env r18dev --remote --file db/schema.sql
scripts.db:init:remote:r18:prod: wrangler d1 execute DB --env r18 --remote --file db/schema.sql
scripts.db:bookmark:dev: wrangler d1 time-travel info DB --env dev
scripts.db:bookmark:r18:dev: wrangler d1 time-travel info DB --env r18dev
scripts.db:bookmark:r18:prod: wrangler d1 time-travel info DB --env r18
